Guided stories for sensitive subject matter.

BINAH, an EVERFI and ADL learning experience, introduces history, perspective-taking and allyship in the context of antisemitism and hate.

Design approach

  • Introductory screens establish historical and cultural context through imagery and focused reading panels.
  • Desktop and mobile treatments retain guided story progression and clear previous/next controls.
  • Compact text panels and listening controls support different ways of moving through the content.

Why this work matters

This material offers a story about pacing and clarity when presenting complex, sensitive educational content.
